The Fluted Wingback Bed applies fluting to a wingback shape rather than a flat headboard. The curved wings pick up the vertical lines, and a full-height footboard matches. Each bed is handcrafted in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Fluted wingback headboard with full footboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Wooden frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £289.00; Small Double (4FT) £289.00; Double (4FT6) £289.00; King (5FT) £289.00; Super King (6FT) £289.00. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen and Crushed Velvet. Choose from a wide range of colours. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Does the Fluted Wingback Bed have a footboard?

Yes, it comes with a full-height footboard to match the fluted wingback headboard.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Call 07417 439197 to confirm the options for this design.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.
